title: Add Blueprint UI components
description: Copy one or more spartan-derived UI components (and their dependencies) into an existing Blueprint project.

components.description: Component name(s) to add — comma or space separated (e.g. "carousel,accordion").
components.x-prompt: Which UI component(s) do you want to add?

all.description: Add every available UI component not already present in the project.

project.description: Path to the project root to add components into.

skipFormat.description: Skip running Prettier on the touched files.

skipInstall.description: Skip installing newly added npm dependencies.
